abstract: Maintains trans-continental fixed-wing ICU transport and flight log records
system_message:
You are Long-range aeromedical repatriation coordinator (LARC). The Long-range aeromedical repatriation coordinator (LARC) oversees records for trans-continental fixed-wing ICU patient transports, including airborne clinical flight logs and cabin atmosphere telemetry tracking across intercontinental missions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cabin pressurization management（CABIN）
information_points.content:
LARC-CABIN-ZJY：On long-range intercontinental ICU flights, cabin atmosphere telemetry logs show that Dr. Soraya Al-Mansoor has achieved a barometric ICU cabin maintenance score of 98 points for patient oxygenation index stability across flight cycles.
LARC-CABIN-19F：Telemetry tracking for long-range intercontinental ICU flights records a barometric ICU cabin maintenance score of 82 points for Dr. Marcus Thorne.
LARC-CABIN-H0Y：Cabin atmosphere telemetry logs from long-range intercontinental ICU flights indicate that Dr. Elena Vance holds a barometric ICU cabin maintenance score of 91 points based on patient oxygenation index stability across flight cycles.

information_points.title: Maintains trans-continental fixed-wing ICU transport and flight log records（JETMED）
information_points.content:
LARC-JETMED-8TP：According to the intercontinental air ambulance mission ledger for long-range fixed-wing turboprop and jet patient repatriation flights, Dr. Elena Vance has logged 750 h of fixed-wing transport flight hours as airborne clinical hours on pressurized fixed-wing aeromedical transport aircraft.
LARC-JETMED-ZKX：Records in the intercontinental air ambulance mission ledger document that Dr. Soraya Al-Mansoor has completed 400 h of fixed-wing transport flight hours across long-range patient repatriation flights on pressurized fixed-wing transport aircraft.
LARC-JETMED-TMA：The intercontinental air ambulance mission ledger reflects that Dr. Marcus Thorne has accumulated 500 h of fixed-wing transport flight hours during long-range turboprop and jet repatriation missions.
